title: Label Coverage Bounds Pooled Macro F1: A Reporting Diagnostic for Closed-Set IDS Benchmarks: Reproducibility Artifact
description: Code, fold-count audits, confusion matrices and manuscript sources for a pre-fit label-coverage check. Includes five-seed NSL-KDD pipeline comparisons, CICIDS2017 binary refits, a conditional audit of a published leave-one-family-out score, same-prediction target reanalyses, and the full UNSW pair grid. This metadata file does not establish a deposited record or DOI.
